title: Blood Golem
description: The golem has become filled with blood But he is kind if you don't hit him
body:
This custom texture pack boldly reimagines the iconic Iron Golem, transforming the gentle village guardian into a figure of mysterious and slightly ominous intrigue. The modification focuses specifically on the finer details, completely shifting the entity's aesthetic without altering its blocky fundamental shape. Most strikingly, the vines draped over the golem’s massive shoulders and torso have been recolored from their natural, mossy green to a deep, blood-crimson red. This alteration vividly suggests that the giant might be corrupted by ancient magic or permanently stained from countless battles, giving the metallic beast a much darker, more aggressive appearance.

Complementing this, the eyes have been meticulously tweaked to stand out against the iron grey. While the default golem features soft, friendly eyes, this new design introduces a sharper, more intense gaze that feels robotic and unyielding. The high contrast between the weathered iron plating and the vibrant red elements creates a visually arresting look. It makes the mob feel less like a passive protector and more like a sentient war machine. This texture pack is perfect for players seeking to add a layer of depth, proving that small tweaks can profoundly change the atmosphere of a village.
